designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service acquired the land for Conscience Point National Wildlife Refuge, 60 acres of maritime grassland at Southampton on Long Island, by donation from a private individual.
designationHistory.note: One FWS web source, which gives the acquisition year (1964), not a formal establishment date. Wikipedia and other secondary sites give a different year (1971); not resolved.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Amagansett NWR 'About Us' page (Long Island NWR Complex listing)
